opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Applicants may need postgraduate qualifications (e.g. PhD) or already hold doctorates seeking a postdoctoral placement.
opportunities.summary: Cara's rescue-mission fellowship programme helps academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death to escape to temporary refuge at universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) where they can continue their work. Cara checks each applicant's background and references, helps identify host institutions, negotiates placements, allocates additional funding from its own resources, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family. Fellowships are typically for 2 or 3 years. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
